--- ## Walkthrough Refactors e2e test helpers to centralize MAPI MachineSet retrieval, decode AWS provider specs from the MachineSet, pass the MachineSet plus cluster Infrastructure into AWS machine template generation via the production conversion path, and update tests and helpers to build the AWS client from the decoded region. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**ProviderSpec helpers**
`e2e/framework/providerspec.go`|Added `GetFirstMAPIMachineSet` to encapsulate MachineSet list/sort/selection; `GetMAPIProviderSpec[T]` now delegates MachineSet selection to this helper.| |**AWS template generation**
`e2e/aws_helpers.go`, `e2e/machineset_migration_helpers.go`|Refactored `newAWSMachineTemplate` signature to accept `*mapiv1beta1.MachineSet` and `*configv1.Infrastructure`; switched construction to use `mapi2capi.FromAWSMachineSetAndInfra(...).ToMachineSetAndMachineTemplate()` and updated callers to decode provider spec from the first MAPI MachineSet.| |**E2E tests and setup**
`e2e/aws_test.go`, `e2e/machineset_migration_helpers.go`|Tests now obtain the default MAPI MachineSet via `GetFirstMAPIMachineSet`, decode AWS provider spec with `mapi2capi.AWSProviderSpecFromRawExtension`, build AWS client from decoded region, and use the returned `awsMachineTemplate.Name`/`mapiDefaultMS.Name` directly.| |**Global infra state**
`e2e/e2e_common.go`|Introduced package-level `infra *configv1.Infrastructure` and updated `InitCommonVariables()` to populate that global variable for use by template conversion and helpers.| |**Dependencies / toolchain**
`e2e/go.mod`|Bumped Go toolchain from `1.25.0` to `1.25.3`, adjusted direct/indirect module requirements (added module pseudo-version for local module and swapped several indirect deps).| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Addressing warnings is optional. ### ❌ Failed checks (1 warning, 1 inconclusive) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :---------------------------------: | :------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Test Structure And Quality | ⚠️ Warning | The refactored test code in aws_helpers.go contains multiple Eventually calls without explicit timeout and interval parameters, violating established codebase pattern. | Update Eventually calls on lines 75, 105, and 141 to include explicit timeout and interval parameters using framework constants like WaitShort and RetryShort. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ❓ Inconclusive | Test files mentioned in PR summary could not be located in repository for verification of Ginkgo test name stability. | Verify that test files are accessible and search Ginkgo test constructs for dynamic values like IDs, timestamps, or runtime-specific information. |
✅ Passed checks (10 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly summarizes the main refactoring: updating newAWSMachineTemplate to use mapi2capi. It is specific, concise, and directly related to the primary change in the changeset. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | Docstring coverage is 100.00% which is sufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This pull request does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests. All changes are limited to refactoring existing test helper functions and modifying the setup logic of already-existing tests. Since the MicroShift Test Compatibility check applies specifically to new test blocks being added, and no new tests are present in this PR, the check is not applicable and passes. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The AWS e2e test creates a single MachineSet with 1 replica and is fully compatible with Single Node OpenShift deployments. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only e2e test utilities in the e2e/ directory, not deployment manifests, operator code, or controllers, so the topology-aware scheduling check is not applicable. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR modifications do not introduce OTE Binary Stdout Contract violations; all stdout-writing code remains within test helpers with proper Ginkgo interception. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo e2e tests were added in this PR; only helper functions and utilities were refactored, containing no hardcoded IPv4 addresses or external connectivity requirements. |
